control_check.environment: capture host only (macOS arm64, Apple clang, libc++, -std=c++17); no Docker harness, coverage or AFL++ overlay was built because the path has no primary metric

control_check.build_note: The v0.5.0 single header uses std::streamsize without including <ios>; under libc++ the harness includes <ios> first.
